name: Mix★Max Kimi to Boku to no Aida ni wa...
original_name: MIX★MAX キミとボクとの間には・・・
source:
Main character is a member of microcomputer club which mostly includes ghost members. In order for the club to survive he must demonstrate achievements in culture within a month. With that the fight for club survival began.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是微机社成员，社团里大多是幽灵成员。为了让社团存续，他必须在一个月内展示文化成果。社团存亡之战就此开始。
